name: build-hex
description: Hexagonal-architecture backend topology — 14 agents across 3 teams (planning, engineering, validation) with a per-Task quality loop (qa → refactor-advisor → code-reviewer), plus a standalone proof-reviewer that runs the change-driven proof gate for /board-flow:prove (JaCoCo/PIT/jqwik). Path-lock keyed to the standard domain/application/api-rest/infrastructure/bootstrap Maven layout. No external tracker integration — pair with board-flow for Jira lifecycle.
